summary.zh: 搭好经营框架、指标与会议节奏
summary.en: Set up EOS, Scaling Up or OKRs with scorecards and rhythms

description.zh: 帮公司确定用什么方式运转，可选 EOS、Scaling Up 或 OKR，并落地责任分工表、周度指标看板、会议节奏和季度重点。适合制度跟不上规模、目标总是落空的时候。
description.en: Helps choose how the company runs, whether EOS, Scaling Up or OKRs, then sets up the accountability chart, weekly scorecard, meeting rhythm and quarterly rocks. Fits a company whose goals keep slipping for lack of a system.
